admission.justification: The case {'path': 'mcp/tests/test_atomic_write.py', 'symbol': 'test_an_impossible_process_number_is_not_known_to_be_gone'} proves this obligation on the candidate.

applicability: A published atomic write whose temporary-file cleanup probes whether a writer that held the target is gone.
conditions: The destination has already been replaced by the atomic write.
The probe reads an operating-system process number from a file beside the destination.
exclusions: Temporary files whose names carry no process number.
Process probes outside the atomic-write cleanup.

evidence: focused.txt; negative-O1.txt; candidate tree in FROZEN.json

statement: An impossible operating-system process number does not establish that a temporary-file writer is gone and cannot turn an already-published atomic write into a failure.
